linear incised/outlined figures without interior modelling
justification: A shows narrative figural imagery \u2014 a large striding human brandishing an object, an animal, and a manned boat with a row of crew strokes above the hull \u2014 while B shows a non-narrative sign-field: an oval cartouche-like enclosure containing a standing bird and small signs, flanked by vertical bands of repeated chevrons and dashes. The only real correspondences are generic: a profile bird-like creature and rows of repeated short strokes forming a band, plus a broadly schematic, outline-based manner of depiction; the relationships (crew standing in a boat vs. signs enclosed in an oval) are quite different.
